name: TIM2 resource filename hash

algorithm.phase1: Weighted sum and XOR checksum: for each char c at position i, wsum += c * weight[i%16] (IMUL16), xorsum ^= c. Characters 0x5C (\) and 0x3A (:) reset both to 0.
algorithm.phase2: Pad filename to 13 bytes with NULs (null-padded 13-byte buffer).
algorithm.phase3: 32-bit ROL8 hash over 4 iterations: for each index in hash_idx (positions 0,1,4,7 of the 13-byte buffer), rotate DX:AX left by 8 bits then add the character at that position (with carry propagation).
algorithm.phase4: Final combine: multiply wsum × xorsum (signed IMUL16) → low word. CWD sign-extends to DX (0xFFFF if product >= 0x8000, else 0x0000). Add product to low word of rotation, add sign-extension + carry to high word. Result is (high << 16) | low.

key_insights: The hash_idx array at DGROUP:0x01AA is overwritten at runtime from the MAP header. EXE default is [0,1,6,7]; MAP header specifies [0,1,4,7].
IMUL16 is signed: (a * b) & 0xFFFF where both operands are signed 16-bit. High word of the full 32-bit product is discarded.
CWD after IMUL sign-extends the low word: if bit 15 (0x8000) is set, DX = 0xFFFF; else DX = 0x0000.
The ROL32 helper at CS:0x199B uses POP/PUSH/RETF thunk (not CALL). SHL/SHR on DX:AX with carry chain.
